text_003: This policy explains what information this website collects and how it is used.
text_005: When you use the contact form, the details you enter (such as your name, email, company, website and message) are sent through FormSubmit, a third-party form service, to younusshobon@gmail.com so I can reply. You can email me directly instead. They are not sold or shared for marketing.
text_007: This site may use Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity to understand how visitors use it. These services may set cookies and collect usage data such as pages viewed, device type and approximate location.
text_009: Some pages embed Google Maps, which is loaded from Google and subject to Google's privacy policy.
text_011: You can ask to access or delete information you've sent me by getting in touch through the contact page.
text_013: Questions about this policy can be sent via the contact page
